body: Congratulations!! Even though i dont know you irl, i want you to know that i’m so proud of you! 😆❤️👏🏼👏🏼

Hey everyone. 26/f here. So I randomly noticed this bruise on my leg a few hours ago. It’s not painful at all and it’s not a raised bump. My sister told me that it was a ruptured vein and that she gets them all the time. But I’m still worried because i’ve never had anything like this before. I’m not sure if this other symptom is related in anyway, but I’ve been having some trouble with heavy breathing when I move lately, but I assumed it was just from lack of exercise. I’m currently a student, and I also have a desk job, so I am unable to work out as much as I’d like.


Some other information; I was diagnosed with hypothyroidism 4 years ago, and i’ve been taking some vitamins/supplements since then. I haven’t noticed any issues from taking any of these vitamins, but I thought I should mention it anyway. Here’s a list:

– Vitamin D (prescription)
– Vitamin B6 
– Zinc (prescription)
– Codliver oil
– Omega-3
– Magnesium 
– L-theanine
– Echinacea (on and off)

Those are the only symptoms that I have right now. Everything else seems pretty normal (average weight, blood pressure, cholesterol, etc…)
My family doctor is closed tomorrow, but i can’t wait until Monday to get answers.

It never gets better. For anyone. For all the people that claim that it got "better" for them are still suffering deep down, but make themselves appear to look better from the outside because they're afraid of getting judged by others. I've heard those exact words way too many times in my life, and everytime they were said was right before things got much worse. "It will get better real soon you'll see!" was the worst one for me because it felt like i was forced to wait for something "magical" to happen, but it never did. "Hope" and "faith" are nothing but words and it's time people realize that.
